subject.title: build(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group with 9 updates

question: Should maintainers land this grouped production dependency upgrade as one batch, or split/hold the higher-risk runtime and rendering packages?
rationale: The diff is mechanically clean and CI is green, but grouped production dependency upgrades can change runtime, rendering, email, and native binary behavior in ways automation cannot fully prove.

options.title: Land The Batch After Final Checks
options.body: Accept the grouped upgrade once the final merge-commit checks are green and own the compatibility risk as normal dependency maintenance.

options.title: Split Higher-Risk Packages
options.body: Ask Dependabot or a maintainer to split Convex, Shiki/Mermaid, Sharp, and Resend into smaller PRs for easier rollout and rollback.

options.title: Close And Wait For Next Batch
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want to take the grouped production dependency risk this cycle.

recommendation.title: Land The Batch After Final Checks
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped upgrade once the final merge-commit checks are green and own the compatibility risk as normal dependency maintenance.
